edges: The case Jordan v. Kollman outlines the elements of libel.
The Virginia Supreme Court case established elements of libel.

multi_hop_neighbors.edge: Other fraternities on campus may have a harder time bringing a defamation lawsuit.
Defamation law must be balanced against freedom of speech protections.
A private individual must prove that a false factual statement was published about them that harmed their reputation.
Defamation cases are often threatened but rarely filed.
